items.title: Goldman sees Cybercab giving Tesla a cost advantage in robotaxis
items.summary: Investing.com -- Tesla’s Cybercab could give the company a cost advantage in the autonomous-vehicle market, but its ability to scale robotaxi operations will depend more on software performance than manufacturing costs, Goldman Sachs analysts said. Tesla hosted a Cybercab launch event in Austin on Sept. 3 and has begun offering robotaxi rides in the vehicle, according to the Goldman Sachs research note.
